reviews.body:
The change swaps substring matching of the SSE stream terminator for exact matching on the trimmed data value, fixing premature stream termination when payloads mention the terminator text. Template edits are consistent across all four call sites and the two new tests cover both plain and discriminated SSE paths. No blocking issues found; one note about seed snapshots being intentionally out of scope per the PR description.
